sentences.text: 4. It has been alleged that the daughter of the informant was allured by the accused persons on the pretext of giving her employment and subsequently she was sold at Delhi.

5. Submission has been advanced by learned counsel for the appellant that so far as the present appellant is concerned the only allegation is of alluring the victim and as regards commission of rape upon the victim is concerned the same is attributed to the husband of the appellant.

Learned counsel has referred to the evidence of the victim who has been examined as P.W.-2 while submitting that save and except the allegation of allurement there is no further allegation so far as the present appellant is concerned.
It has been submitted that the appellant was all along on bail during trial.
6. On consideration of the limited role depicted by the P.W.-2 as regards the present appellant is concerned, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly, during the pendency of this appeal, appellant, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.
10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I-cum- Special Judge (POCSO), Lohardaga in Special POCSO Case No. 34 of 2020.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge-I-cum- Special Judge (POCSO), Lohardaga
